{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows sustained positive sentiment (e.g., >0.50) and model overestimates prices.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if recent true outcomes show mean reversion after sharp spikes.",
    "Increase forecast lag by 1-2 days if sentiment history indicates market uncertainty (e.g., alternating 0.00/0.33 values).",
    "Apply downward bias correction if model consistently overpredicts prices during high sentiment periods (e.g., sentiment >0.50 for 3+ consecutive days).",
    "Cap forecast growth after 3 consecutive days of upward sentiment to prevent overshoot.",
    "If true outcome is significantly lower than forecast (e.g., >10% below), reduce next forecast by 10-15% to account for persistent underperformance.",
    "When sentiment history shows a recent drop (e.g., from 0.50 to 0.00), adjust forecast to reflect potential price correction."
  ]
}
